title: The Monte Carlo group at the top of the Knights of Malta, with Kissinger and Bush Sr.
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of The Monte Carlo group at the top of the Knights of Malta, with Kissinger and Bush Sr., about unspecified at Knights of Malta / Monte Carlo, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a thing called the Monte Carlo group that is at the top top of the entire nice of Malta structure.

plain: Danny Sheehan, a lawyer, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about what he calls the Monte Carlo group. He says it sits at the very top of the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic religious order, and names former US secretary of state Henry Kissinger and former president George Bush Senior in connection with it. If true, it would mean a small, hidden circle of powerful men sits above that order.
